posts.name: Ishaan Sameer Sawant
posts.cooked:
Hello IITM Team,
As per your guidance I opened my same (the same I used for last term SC VM) ssh key which is

ssh 24f2007256@se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in

and when I did ls/opt/se2001 I even got the latest release BPT1 from problem 1-4

image1600×213 155 KB

but when I tried to create a new directory as mkdir bpt1 inside se2001 for solving question
I realised I already have all the bpts there

image1600×343 200 KB

and when I did synchro init and synchro eval it was already solved

image705×445 217 KB

so what to do in this scenario ??

Please guide me

posts.name: Mukesh Ram
posts.cooked: are you repeating oppe in this term??

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked:
If you are only repeating the OPPE this term you can just submit the BPTs again using synchro eval, which you’ve already done. That should be enough for OPPE eligibility.

Check this thread for a better idea about this -

Repeat OPPE for system commands System Commands
Hello everyone, I have a doubt. I am repeating system commands oppe this term. In my Vm, previous BPT’s are there. Do i have to delete those and complete the BPT again as it is mandatory to do BPT for appearing in oppe?

posts.name: Ishaan Sameer Sawant
posts.cooked: yes i am repeating oppe in this term
